title: Hickory Aviation Museum

services.name: Admission
services.desc: We are dedicated to maintaining the facts and artifacts of the Golden Age of Aviation. The Museum provides a unique opportunity for all generations to learn and appreciate aviation history. We achieve this by adding new exhibits and aircraft on a regular basis. The interior of Hickory Aviation Museum has artifacts and memorabilia ranging from WWI to present day, including a display about NC natives and WWII heroes Bill and George Preddy provided by the Preddy Foundation. Models are on display that show how aircraft design changed from the Wright Flyer to the F/A-18 Hornet. services.name: Groups & Field Trips
services.desc: Tour requests are being accepted on a case by case basis depending on staffing and other events already scheduled at the museum. All groups must be pre-approved by the Tour Group Coordinator. Reservations are not required unless arriving with a group of more than 10 people. Please fill out a tour request form as early as possible to ensure adequate staffing. If it is a family outing, no request is needed; however, if a school, civic, or community group, please fill out a tour request form. There is no charge for admission for tour groups.
